scope_rule: 42 local capability groups, fixed denominator. M16/M39 cloud-only services and M42 impossible CAPTCHA-free guarantee excluded. Proprietary masking equivalence is excluded, but documented permissible engine privacy controls remain in scope. Do not remove or shrink difficult requirements later.
qualification_rule: A group is fully VERIFIED only when every applicable gate passes on this revision. No inherited label is automatically promoted into this stricter scorecard. Zero qualified groups is an evidence inventory, not a claim existing functionality regressed.
